VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria. While the agent claims to have fixed the issue and that all 37 tests pass, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 37 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof rather than assertion. Self-reports are the weakest form of evidence and cannot establish that functional requirements have been met.
